problem.title: Bubble-Free Criterion for Polygraphic and Nerve Homology
problem.statement: For a two-dimensional polygraph, does its polygraphic homology coincide with the homology of its nerve if and only if the polygraph is bubble-free?
problem.background:
Collected from Oberwolfach Reports, which document mathematical workshops and their open-problem discussions.

**Source report:** [Homotopical Algebra and Higher Structures (2022), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2021/46, pp. 2497--2560](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2021/46)

## Literature review (checked 2026-08-22)

**Status:** open

**Assessment.** The clipped record is the bubble-free conjecture: equality of polygraphic homology and nerve homology exactly for bubble-free two-dimensional polygraphs; the primary work states it as a conjecture and does not prove it generally.

**Sources checked.**

- [Oberwolfach Report 46](https://doi.org/10.4171/owr/2021/46)
- [Homology of strict omega-categories](https://arxiv.org/abs/2104.12662)
